label: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. Names, IDs, locations, rates and rooms are not live provider data.
question: Which saved hotels in ZIP 16802 have a room from October 10 to October 12, 2026, for under $250 total? Compare the total costs.
sql: SELECT h.hotel_id, h.name, h.address, SUM(n.nightly_rate_cents) AS total_cost_cents FROM saved_hotels h JOIN demo_hotel_nights n ON n.hotel_id=h.hotel_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saved_hotel_searches s WHERE s.hotel_id=h.hotel_id AND s.zip_code='16802') AND n.stay_date>='2026-10-10' AND n.stay_date<'2026-10-12' GROUP BY h.hotel_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.stay_date)=2 AND MIN(n.rooms_available)>=1 AND SUM(n.nightly_rate_cents)<25000 ORDER BY total_cost_cents,h.hotel_id LIMIT 50
mock_answer: Using simulated course data, Pine House (fixture) is the lowest-cost match: $200 total for one room for two nights, October 10–12, 2026, with at least 2 rooms on each night [1]. Elm Court (fixture) costs $240 total and has at least 1 room each night [2]. Pine saves $40. Checkout October 12 is excluded; taxes and fees are not supplied. These are saved local records, not live availability or a reservation.
